name: comments
title: Comments
description: A record's comments: a list with a count, Load earlier, skeleton and empty states, comments with edit/delete/copy link, emoji reactions and an attachments slot, a composer with mentions and uploads, and CommentThread — a quoted thread with replies and resolve.

meta.whenToUse: Discussion on a record's page (a task, a meeting): comments oldest first with the composer at the end.
meta.whenNotToUse: An activity feed or notifications — use Inbox.
